_about: Premium kit demo (engine/premium-kit, BETA, not a product template): exercises every premium-kit feature at once so the kit can be eyeballed. Speed ramps (take.ramp / scene.ramp), the SFX design pass (riser > hit > tail on cuts, soft whoosh on text in, ticks on word pops, ducking), eased punch-ins with blur, whip / zoom-through transitions, a grade preset, and the drop (riser, silence, boom, cut ladder). See engine/docs/premium-kit.md. Not a product template. captions.chestFirst is dropped: the fork placer (safezone.mjs) has no chestFirst.
